reasoning: Shiny black discoloration covering the stalk rind across internodes, with coalesced dark lesions forming large black blotches - the hallmark symptom of Anthracnose stalk rot. Distinguished from Physoderma stalk rot (black confined to nodes), Bacterial stalk rot (soft slimy rot with collapse), Diplodia stalk rot (tan/dried with pycnidia), and Charcoal stalk rot (internal shredded pith with microsclerotia).
